title: Data residency: where is your data stored, and where do AI features process it?
summary: The storage commitments, processing exceptions, licensing rules and control paths are supported by Microsoft documentation. The ADR migration path is valid despite the automatic warning; minor corrections should acknowledge conflicting role guidance and add the supporting comparison source.

claims.claim: Data residency is the geographic location where an organisation's data is stored or processed.
claims.quote: Data Residency refers to the geographic location where an organization's data is stored or processed.

claims.claim: Move data across regions is at Power Platform admin center > Manage > Environments > environment > Generative AI features > Edit > Move data across regions.
claims.quote: In the navigation pane, select Manage. ... select Environments. ... Select the name of your environment. ... In the Generative AI features card, select Edit. ... select the Move data across regions checkbox.

claims.claim: Set-PowerPlatformGenerativeAiSettings -EnvironmentName <EnvironmentId> -CrossGeoDataMovement $false disables cross-geo movement for the named environment.
claims.quote:
-CrossGeoDataMovement
Enables or disables cross-geo data movement.
Type: Boolean
-EnvironmentName
Specifies the ID of the environment you want to modify.

claims.claim: Move data across regions requires a Power Platform administrator or Dynamics 365 administrator.
claims.quote: To grant consent, you must be a Power Platform administrator or Dynamics 365 administrator.
claims.fix: Add to the Roles bullet: 'The Power Platform page names Power Platform administrator or Dynamics 365 administrator; the Copilot Studio data-movement page instead says only global and Power Platform administrators can enable or disable these features outside the United States (https://learn.microsoft.com/microsoft-copilot-studio/manage-data-movement-outside-us).'

claims.claim: Microsoft does not document an admin UI operation that sets a user's Preferred Data Location.
claims.quote: Searched: PreferredDataLocation cloud user set admin center UI edit; "preferred data location" "edit" "admin center". Opened m365-multi-geo-user-testing; UI verifies PDL, while setting it is documented with Graph PowerShell or on-premises AD.

claims.claim: Update-MgUser -UserId <UserId> -PreferredDataLocation <international location code> sets a cloud-only user's PDL.

Setting Preferred Data Location (PDL) for cloud only users
Use the following script format:
$userUPN="<user's UPN>"
$user = Get-MgUser -UserId $userUPN
Update-MgUser -UserId $user.Id -PreferredDataLocation <international location code>

claims.claim: Synchronised users' PDL must be populated in on-premises Active Directory and synchronised through Microsoft Entra Connect.

Synchronize user's Preferred Data Location (PDL) using Microsoft Entra Connect

claims.where: What it is: Where data is stored
claims.claim: The sign-up country or region establishes the tenant's Default Geography.
claims.quote: When your organization creates a Microsoft 365 Tenant, a country or region is provided during sign-up. This country or region establishes the Default Geography for Microsoft 365 services.

claims.where: What it is: Where data is stored
claims.claim: Microsoft determines storage geography using Default Geography and each service's geographic availability.
claims.quote: The provisioning logic uses the Default Geography combined with service availability to determine where data is stored.

claims.claim: Product Terms, Multi-Geo and ADR are three methods for durable commitments on Microsoft 365 data location.
claims.quote:
There are three methods for ensuring that the Tenant data location for a particular Microsoft 365 service doesn't change.
1. Product Terms ...
2. Multi-Geo ...
3. Advanced Data Residency

claims.quote:
Data Residency Commitments Available for Microsoft 365 Copilot and Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat
Product Terms
Required Conditions:
1. Tenant has a sign-up country/region included in Australia, Brazil, Canada, the European Union

claims.where: What it is: commitment table, Product Terms; Cost and licensing

claims.quote: These commitments are included for Tenants that meet specific eligibility criteria. No additional purchase is required.
